papers.title_en: Gravitational Waves as a Source of Large-Scale White Noise: New Constraints
papers.evidence: 利用脉冲星计时阵列的引力波探测对随机引力波背景施加新约束。
papers.tldr: 随机引力波背景在宇宙流体中产生剪切，通过非线性模式耦合在曲率密度场中生成大尺度白噪声（LSWN）。针对这一机制，本文基于LSWN理论框架推导了引力波诱导的LSWN振幅，并利用观测对该噪声的非探测结果，将其转化为对引力波产生红移和密度参数的约束。所得最小约束为z_*^2 Ω_GW0^* < 5×10^7 (f_*/nHz)^{3/2}，例如可排除脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波在红移z_*~10^8之前存在，该时期远晚于夸克-强子相变。这一约束比现有其他引力波约束强数个数量级，且若采用更现实的早期宇宙引力波产生模型（考虑源粒度和声波产生的LSWN），约束还会进一步收紧，因此本文给出的是基础性最小限制。
papers.abstract_en: A stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background sources a shear in the flow of cosmic fluid which, through non-linear mode coupling, generates large-scale white noise (LSWN) in the kurvature density field. Building on the LSWN framework of our previous work, we derive the amplitude of this GW-induced LSWN and translate the observational non-detection of LSWN into bounds on the production redshift and density of gravity waves. In particular, a minimal constraint on gravity waves with $z=0$ density parameter $Ω_\mathrm{GW0}^*$ in frequency band $f_*$ generated at redshift $z_*$ must satisfy ${z_*}^2\,Ω_\mathrm{GW0}^*<5\times10^7\,(f_*/\mathrm{nHz})^{3/2}$. This, for example, precludes the gravity waves recently detected by pulsar timing arrays \cite{NANOGrav:2023hvm} from being present before $z_*\sim10^8$, long after the quark hadron phase transition. While orders of magnitude stronger than other constraints on gravity waves, this is a minimal LSWN constraint as realistic modeling of early universe gravity wave production, including the granularity of the gravity-wave sources and the LSWN produced by the associated acoustic waves would probably tighten this constraint by orders of magnitude.

papers.title_en: Statistical treatment of searches for counterparts of positionally-uncertain astrophysical sources: from flux upper limits to detection
papers.authors: Julian Sitarek, Abelardo Moralejo, Juan Jiménez Quiles, Giacomo D'Amico, Andrea Simongini, Antonio Stamerra
papers.evidence: 为定位不精确的瞬变源（如快速射电暴）对应体搜寻提供统计方法
papers.tldr: 多信使天体物理中，不同仪器定位精度差异导致对应体搜索需统计处理。论文研究了利用警报概率密度函数的频率派与贝叶斯方法，以及不使用该信息的不可知方法。通过一维模拟和引力波事件伽马射线望远镜跟随模拟，发现频率派和贝叶斯对弱信号表现相当且优于不可知方法。该工作为位置不确定源的统计搜索提供了系统比较与实用指导。
papers.abstract_en: Rapid growth of the multimessenger and multiwavelength astrophysics had led to an increasing number of observations of the same events with instruments with different point spread functions. In particular pointing instruments with good angular resolution are used to pin-point the source of poorly-localized alert. In case no clear detection of the source counterpart is reached, the interpretation of the results requires statistical analysis. We investigate two approaches using the probability density function of the alert: frequentist and Bayesian, as well as agnostic approach not using this information. We discuss the advantages and problems of all the methods, and compare their reliability and performance. We consider both a simple one-dimensional toy simulations and a realistic use case of full simulations of the follow-up of a gravitational wave event with gamma-ray telescopes. The performance of both frequentist and Bayesian approaches for weak signals is comparable and superior to the agnostic one.
